articles.headline: Boston Scientific says cyberattack is causing global disruption to operations
articles.summary: A cyberattack disrupting a major medical-device manufacturer is a business-risk story, not just a security headline. It can affect production, shipments, customer support, and compliance for healthcare buyers that depend on uninterrupted supply.

articles.headline: Anthropic expected to tell investors it sees over $30 trillion in potential revenue
articles.summary: A huge revenue outlook from a leading AI company underscores how aggressively the market is pricing enterprise adoption of AI. For businesses, this signals intensifying competition, likely higher spending on AI tooling, and continued pressure to evaluate ROI carefully.

articles.headline: Nvidia profit doubles as AI spending keeps surging
articles.summary: Nvidia’s blowout results point to continued heavy investment in AI infrastructure, which can influence chip supply, cloud pricing, and enterprise AI planning. Companies dependent on GPUs, memory, and cloud capacity should expect demand pressure to remain elevated.
